name: Ultrasound — one display set for each sweep
notes: An ultrasound series can hold the single images of several sweeps. The
default rules put all of the single images in one stack.
With this rule, each sweep becomes its own display set, in time order. A
sweep is a run of images with no gap in time longer than
`timeClustersMaxGap` seconds (20 for this rule; the default context uses
30). The description gets the start of the sweep, in seconds from the
The rule claims single-frame US images that have a time, and only in a
series with two or more sweeps. Multi-frame clips stay with the default
Priority -1: the rule runs before every default rule.

usTimeClusters.description: Ultrasound single images: one display set for each sweep of contiguous acquisition time.
